[Intro]

[Verse 1]
[Em]Hollywood's bleeding, [D]vampires feedin'
[C]Darkness turns to [Am]dust
[Em]Everyone's gone, but [D]no one's leavin'
[C]Nobody left but [Am]us
[Em]Tryna chase a feelin', [D]but we'll never feel it
[C]Ridin' on the last train [Am]home
[Em]Dyin' in our sleep, we're [D]livin' out a dream We
[C]only make it out [Am]alone

[Chorus]
[C]I just keep on hopin' that you [D]call me You
[Em]say you wanna see me, but you [G]can't right now You
[C]never took the time to get to [D]know me Was
[Em]scared of losin' somethin' that we never found We're
[C]running out of reasons, [D]but we can't let
[Em]go [G]Yeah,
[C]Hollywood is bleeding, [D]but we call it
[Em]home

[Verse 2]
[Em]Outside, [D]the winter sky turnin'
[C]grey City up in [Am]smoke, it's only ash when it
[Em]rains Howl at the [D]moon and go to sleep in the
[C]day Love for [Am]everybody 'til the drugs fade a-
[Em]way In the mornin', [D]blocking out the sun with the
[C]shades She gotta check her [Am]pulse and tell herself that she o-
[Em]kay It seem like dying [D]young is an honor
[C]But who'd be at my [Am]funeral? I wonder
[Em]I go out, and all they [D]eyes on me
[C]I show out, do you like [Am]what you see?
[Em]And now they closin' [D]in on me
[C]Let 'em sharpen all they [Am]teeth This is more than I can
[C]handle Blood in my [D]Lambo' Wish I could
[Em]go, oh, I'm losin' [G]hoope I light a
[C]candle, some Palo [D]Santo For all these
[Em]demons, wish I could just go on

[Chorus]
[C]I just keep on hopin' that you [D]call me You
[Em]say you wanna see me, but you [G]can't right now You
[C]never took the time to get to [D]know me Was
[Em]scared of losin' somethin' that we never found We're
[C]running out of reasons, [D]but we can't let
[Em]go [G]Yeah,
[C]Hollywood is bleeding, [D]but we call it
[Em]home
title: Hollywood's Bleeding
